summary: Pilot-only screen exploration: F-test vs ExtraTrees vs MI, coarse GB/RF/LR CV landscape
reasoning: The miss is established (holdout_auc 0.5639 < 0.71 at cv_auc 0.761, step-7 of madelon-2026-11-15-2), so no need to recompute it. My job is the compact boost route. First step: a pilot-only diagnostic run that never touches data/heldout.csv. It computes three candidate screens on the 400 pilot rows (ANOVA F, ExtraTrees Gini importance, mutual information), compares top-k (20/30/40/50) with quick CV AUCs for gradient boosting vs RF vs logistic, and gauges how much the fixed-screen CV inflates vs screening inside the folds. From that landscape I will pick the screen type, k, and a small GB tuning grid, before running a proper repeated nested CV as the screen-lock run. All numbers here are pilot-only, so they are visible to me; only the final heldout scoring must be a single locked run.
